ruling.recommended_action: Human review: recompute off-route segments extra_km on the full unthinned GPS trace against a verified optimal-route baseline (fix the KPE/Orchard polyline jump), then apply RD-2 for any unexempted segment; note the driver's 'the second turn-off was my GPS rerouting' admission for possible RD-1 breach.
ruling.escalation_reason: Route-deviation segments cannot be confirmed exempt or chargeable on this record: the driver's 'GPS rerouting' is not a RD-4 reasonable cause, the 'agreed round the jam' exchange (chat 18:37:30/18:38:10) concerns only the earlier Kranji detour and is timestamped ~3 min into it (RD-5 'before'), no evidence covers the later post-Orchard deviation, no incident facts and no detour fact ids were supplied, and the quoted-route polyline appears internally inconsistent, so the RD-2 refund cannot be computed.

segment_findings.reason: Per the driver's statement this detour was taken to avoid congestion, but RD-4 requires a matching LTA traffic incident on the replaced optimal route (m_from_route <= 300 m, reported before the segment started); the record contains NO incident facts, and per RD-4(b)/G3 the BKE speed-band record (band 5 = free-flow) cannot exempt a segment on its own. The chat contains no rider consent: RD-5 requires the agreement message to be timestamped before the detour began, and no chat message covers the post-Orchard stretch at all (only the unrelated Kranji proposal). No verbal-agreement claim in the driver's statement counts (G11). Evidence for this segment cannot be resolved on the record — G12.

Excess ~5.1 km: timestamp-ordered GPS (distance: 18:52:10 (1.361113,103.780748) -> 18:59:40 (1.332931,103.813489) ~ 4.4 km traced, vs optimal-route points 1.3607,103.78091 -> 1.33362,103.81436 ~ 3.4 km, i.e. ~1.0 km excess; total traced route 25.9 km at 19:14:50 dropoff vs optimal 20.6 km, and fare.distance_km 29.05 vs quote 20.57 km — a ~5.1–6.5 km excess) where the trace leaves Woodlands Ave 1 / BKE and loops down through Kranji / Woodlands Ave 3 before rejoining. Driver attributes it to 'GPS rerouting', which is not a RD-4 reasonable cause (RD-4(c)) and is not contestable rider consent (RD-5: agreement must be explicit and timestamped before the deviation); no chat message covers this segment. Without the underlying off-route fact ids and the instrument's extra_km figures, the RD-2 quantum cannot be computed; the metres above are my own haversine estimate on the thinned 30 s trace only — G12.
